class.name: NetwStagedWrites
class.brief_description: One decoded frame, before anything has been written to a node.
class.description: Decoding and applying are separate because the apply can be refused: a predicting client reconciles against the authoritative row instead of snapping its body, and a seam may reject the write outright. A decoder that wrote as it read would have spent the write before either could say no.

method.name: header
method.description: The header a prediction or display feed reads.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Whether the decoded frame has a consistent key and value shape.
